effectiveness.name: Effectiveness Vote
effectiveness.description: Identify policies most likely to achieve core goals, regardless of ideology
effectiveness.instruction: Vote based on what you believe will be MOST EFFECTIVE at achieving the policy goals, NOT based on ideological preference

compromise.name: Compromise Vote
compromise.description: Identify policies that could achieve broad cross-ideological support
compromise.instruction: Vote for policies you could genuinely support or accept as a reasonable compromise, even if not your first choice

progressive.name: Progressive/Liberal Sort
progressive.description: Identify top policies aligning with progressive/liberal priorities
progressive.instruction: Rank policies by alignment with progressive values and coalition priorities

conservative.name: Conservative Sort
conservative.description: Identify top policies aligning with conservative priorities
conservative.instruction: Rank policies by alignment with conservative values and coalition priorities

innovation.name: Pro-Innovation Sort
innovation.description: Identify top policies promoting innovation and growth
innovation.instruction: Rank policies by potential to advance technology and economic growth

safety.name: Pro-Safety Sort
safety.description: Identify top policies prioritizing safety and risk mitigation
safety.instruction: Rank policies by potential to mitigate risks and protect stakeholders
